# CreativeLive

> > Online learning platform offering expert-led classes in photography, design, business, and creative skills taught by industry professionals like Chase Jarvis and leading practitioners.

CreativeLive provides on-demand video courses and live workshops covering Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, photography techniques, entrepreneurship, productivity, and creative development. The platform features classes from renowned instructors and includes podcast content exploring creative careers and personal growth.

## Key Topics

- Adobe Photoshop
- Adobe Lightroom
- Photography Education
- Portrait Photography
- Photo Editing
- Creative Inspiration
- Entrepreneurship
- Productivity & Time Management
- Digital Workflow
- Chase Jarvis
- Kenna Klosterman
- Self-Improvement
- Creative Business Strategy
- Photography Lighting
- Content Creation

## Adobe Photoshop & Lightroom

- [Introduction To Adobe Photoshop with Ben Willmore](https://www.creativelive.com/class/introduction-to-adobe-photoshop-2020-ben-willmore): Ben Willmore's comprehensive Adobe Photoshop introduction for all levels
- [Workflow in Adobe Lightroom with Jared Platt](https://www.creativelive.com/class/workflow-in-adobe-lightroom-jared-platt): Jared Platt's Adobe Lightroom workflow & file management strategies
- [Photo Design in Photoshop Class | CreativeLive](https://www.creativelive.com/class/design-trends-elements-in-photoshop-khara-plicanic): Khara Plicanic covers Photoshop patterns, brushes & trending effects
- [Panos in Photoshop and Lightroom with Mike Hagen | CreativeLive](https://www.creativelive.com/class/creating-panoramas-in-photoshop-and-lightroom-mike-hagen): Mike Hagen teaches panorama creation in Photoshop & Lightroom

## Photography Techniques & Lighting

- [Lighting 301 with Pye Jirsa, SLR Lounge](https://www.creativelive.com/class/lighting-301-pye-jirsa-slr-lounge): Pye Jirsa's advanced off-camera flash & portrait lighting techniques
- [Photography Lighting Styles with Matthew Smith | CreativeLive](https://www.creativelive.com/class/lighting-styles-working-with-soft-medium-and-hard-light-matthew-jordan-smith): Matthew Jordan Smith covers soft, medium & hard lighting techniques
- [Editorial Food Photography with Andrew Scrivani | CreativeLive](https://www.creativelive.com/class/editorial-food-photography-andrew-scrivani): Andrew Scrivani teaches professional food photography & storytelling

## Business & Brand Strategy

- [Brand Strategy Bootcamp: Develop Actionable Brand Strategies](https://www.creativelive.com/class/brand-strategy-bootcamp-scott-lancaster): Scott Lancaster teaches startup brand strategy & positioning fundamentals
- [The Working Musician Playbook with Matt Halpern](https://www.creativelive.com/class/working-musican-playbook-matt-halpern): Matt Halpern (Periphery) teaches music business & career strategies

## Productivity & Creative Workflow

- [Workflow, Time Management and Productivity for Creatives](https://www.creativelive.com/class/organization-and-time-management-for-creatives-lisa-congdon): Lisa Congdon teaches creative workflow & productivity strategies
- [Master Work (From Home) / Life Balance with Amy Schmittauer Landino](https://www.creativelive.com/class/master-work-from-home-life-balance-amy-landino): Amy Landino's productivity & work-from-home life balance strategies

## Creative Inspiration & Personal Growth

- [The Creative Art of Attention with Julia Cameron, Chase Jarvis](https://www.creativelive.com/class/the-creative-art-of-attention-julia-cameron): Julia Cameron & Chase Jarvis discuss creativity beyond artistic fields
- [Living Life on Purpose with Jay Shetty, Chase Jarvis](https://www.creativelive.com/class/living-life-on-purpose-jay-shetty): Jay Shetty & Chase Jarvis on intentional living & personal purpose
- [How to Tackle Fear and Live Boldly with Luvvie Ajayi Jones, Chase Jarvis](https://www.creativelive.com/class/how-to-tackle-fear-and-live-boldly-luvvie-ajayi-jones): Luvvie Ajayi Jones & Chase Jarvis on overcoming fear & bold living

## Podcasts & Interviews

- [Creating a Decade of YouTube Content with Gavin Hoey, Kenna Klosterman](https://www.creativelive.com/class/creating-a-decade-of-youtube-content-gavin-hoey): Podcast: Gavin Hoey shares 10 years of YouTube content creation insights
- [Capturing Heritage & History in Real Time with Lynsey Weatherspoon, Kenna Klosterman](https://www.creativelive.com/class/capturing-heritage-history-in-real-time-lynsey-weatherspoon): Podcast: Lynsey Weatherspoon on heritage & photojournalism documentation
- [Celebrating Black Women Photographers with Polly Irungu, Kenna Klosterman](https://www.creativelive.com/class/celebrating-black-women-photographers-polly-irungu): Podcast: Polly Irungu on Black Women Photographers community & diversity

## Arts & Crafts

- [How to Create Collage Paper with Andrea Chebeleu](https://www.creativelive.com/class/how-to-create-collage-paper-andrea-chebeleu): Andrea Chebeleu teaches handmade collage paper & mixed media techniques
- [Quilting with Low Volume Fabrics with Cheryl Arkison](https://www.creativelive.com/class/quilting-low-volume-fabrics-cheryl-arkison): Cheryl Arkison teaches low-volume fabric selection & quilting techniques
- [Build a Language Learning Foundation | CreativeLive](https://www.creativelive.com/class/build-a-language-learning-foundation-matthew-youlden): Polyglot Matthew Youlden's foundational language learning strategies
